observer: Claude (Opus 5.5), 9 Nov 2026: the raw scan blurred 3x3, read at a 0.05 grid whole and in crops at 0.02 (0.01 where stated), floor pass; the old cabin's flat plate was not used as a reference
covers: straight down onto the aisle's forward part from above the rear mat, looking aft: the mat aft of the front seats with its steel plug plate, the plates and steps aft of the mat, the radio table's pressed top at image right
notes: Vehicle: the hangar session, ex-NVA 9A33BM3-1 (catalogue g082-g096); nothing in this photo suggests another vehicle. Looking aft (image right is the vehicle's left): the pressed table with the yellow canister beyond it is g091-d's, on the left. Proof of the mat's identity: the plug plate splits the mat into a wide part at image left (vehicle right) and a narrow part at image right; g088-a from the other way has the same plate with the narrow part on the vehicle's left, the ratio matching (about 3:1 and 2.5:1). So the plate is at the mat's forward end, and the steps at image top are aft of it. Not resolved: whether the dark band across y 0.22-0.36 is a slope or a shadow; the transverse seam at y 0.36 kinks there, so a change of surface is likely.
